I think Anton is okay, even if he is grumpy and completely unemployable with those tattoos. I do not trust the woman, and it is not just because she is a cat girl. She doesn't even use a litterbox. It's highly suspicious.

beats.headline: Four cards in front of my face
beats.text: The practice arena lets me choose everything. I pick Arena of the Eulogist, which is packed with cheering Nebulars, and set how much they like us all the way to the top. Combat starts, and four enormous cards float in front of my face like a windshield, so I can't see a thing. By the time I shrink them, Mongo has ripped the monster apart. A Teletubby, I think. The second time I summon Geraldo, and he arrives flipping, with sound effects, in a headband covered in hearts. I throw him Stout and a Time Extend. Uncommons only hold two.

beats.headline: Puddle Jump to the Yellow Zone
beats.text: None of my psionic attacks work on these ghommids. Wall of Fire, though, crackles bigger than ever thanks to my new nipple ring, and my clockwork Mongos tear through them. We are surrounded a hundred meters from the saferoom when Carl shouts shortcut, so I cast Puddle Jump, and everyone lands outside a crumbling crypt with a neon sign: The Yellow Zone. Inside, Sister Ines says the boss cannot hurt us in here, so Carl opens the door again. The boss is standing right there, and he steps right into the room.

beats.headline: The Bard's Golden Throat
beats.text: The gold box from the practice room gives us our first snare card, Hobbled. Then my platinum fan box, which my fans voted on: a real headset microphone, gold with a purple jewel, not a prop like the one at the party. The Bard's Golden Throat. It tunes my songs, doubles my volume and more, and adds charisma. Carl wants it kept as a secret weapon, which I suppose is right, so it goes in my hotlist. Carl's fan box is a massage coupon at the Desperado Club, and he may bring a companion. That is me.

beats.headline: Gossip Girl, on the record
beats.text: Miss Thagra's interview is about television, which means it is about me. I explain that Gossip Girl and Gilmore Girls are two completely different shows, and that Gossip Girl is quite simply the pinnacle of television achievement. Her screencaps are all wrong: one is from the horrific Acapulco spinoff, another from the HBO reboot. She is a Crest, one of those, so I am cool on her at first, but she is genuinely interested, and by the end we are chatting like best friends. Afterwards her producers show me numbered pictures and I call out the proper ones. Number ten is Jane the Virgin.

beats.headline: His mother did not leave
beats.text: Miss Thagra asks Carl about his mother, and I learn she did not leave him. She hanged herself, and he found her. He always said she left, and he never talked about his father either, and I assumed a personal trainer. At some point I am on his lap. Afterwards, in the green room, I tell him that was not very nice of her and ask why he never told Miss Beatrice any of this. He shakes his head. So I lean against the side of his head and let him pat me, and then I ask Zev whether Odette made a special about me. She did. It airs tonight.

beats.headline: A ditty, and a mute
beats.text: I sing us across the graveyard, autotuned: I'll protect you, my pretties, with my voice of an angel and my expertly sung ditties. The whole party is limbered, dexterity up fifty percent. It needs a second verse to stack, and under that kind of pressure the rhyme that comes out is not the one I would have chosen. The system cancels the boost and mutes me for five minutes, which is rude. In the temple Paz asks why I did not simply use "kitties." Then he tells me I am a good singer. He really thinks so.

beats.headline: Mongo, eat the nun
beats.text: Paz tells us her race comes with a skill that makes people want to protect her, and that before the dungeon she poisoned every sister in her convent. I knew it. I said so from the very start. She is frozen right there, so I tell Mongo to eat the nun, and Carl says stop. Fine: not yet, but wait for mommy's sign. In chat I tell Carl we kill her, because we will never trust her again, and killing nuns is almost as bad as killing kittens. He says that is not who we are, and we will separate. I tell him this is not the time for half-measures.

beats.headline: The Thief, from a goddess
beats.text: The goddess Yemaya is the Starbucks logo, and she gives a card to Sister Ines and one to me. Mine has the black border, mythical, second only to unique, and it is a mystic card called The Thief. It lets us steal a card from someone else, it is not even consumable, and with it we have all five kinds. She says she cannot help noticing I have not given myself to a goddess yet, and there may be more prizes if I worship at her altar. I tell her I will have to think about it. But thank you so very much, your goddess-ness.

beats.headline: Only one of us leaves
beats.text: Katia has a purple tiara, and it is so pretty, and it is just like... I go rigid in Carl's lap. Did Louis throw it on her head? No. Eva. I do not want to fight Katia, and only one of us can leave the next floor. Then she shows us a flower, and one of its boons is a baby, and I have questions. Who would be the father? Not Carl, he is a primal. Louis? Juice Box would not like that. And then Katia says the guild she needs is behind a strip club, and a dancer I know never once mentioned it. This is an outrage.

beats.headline: Blocked by the nun
beats.text: I only told Sister Ines the truth: that what she did to Paz was really mean, that killing nuns is not acceptable, that she is a disgrace to all cat kind, and possibly that we will take her cards and rip the Paz card once we find her, and that Mongo is very disappointed in her. She has blocked me. Carl says now she will hide from us, or worse, attack us. Hardly. As if I would let a fake cat sneak up on me. Also, I unmuted Samantha, and she started yelling at me, so I muted her again.

beats.headline: Captain Enormous, proposed
beats.text: Crown Prince Stalwart calls me an imbecile, so I remind him how many times we humiliated him and his brother, and ask whether his mother is here, because I would be happy to sign an autograph for her. Oh wait. He promises to skin me alive and line his codpiece with my pelt, where it will warm his enormous genitals for a thousand years. Nobody had questioned the size of anything, so I propose an action item renaming him Captain Enormous. The Empress trumpets with laughter. The system rejects it: titles may not be changed. Oh, poo.

beats.headline: The Inebriated Dragonfly
beats.text: I have a new tiara. It took me twenty minutes to choose a blank at the gnome jeweler's, and Carl threatened to leave, which is not how one shops. Then we paid 25,000 gold to set the citrine in it. I did not like the colour until I read what it does: half the potion cooldown, ten more intelligence, no clumsiness when inebriated, and a Hover skill. I can fly now. I am like Wonder Woman. Carl says I only get five a day, and that I have used four.

beats.headline: She fights with people
beats.text: It is a card floor and I have a deck, and Shi Maria is going into it. She is somebody, which is not the same thing as a mob with a number over its head. Carl saw straight through her and made an arrangement: she becomes a card, and we take her down to the next floor with us. I will play her when I need her. It is a game. That is what the cards are for.

beats.headline: A waste management company
beats.text: In the middle of a practice fight I get the notification: Empress D'Nadia has sold my sponsorship. I am not a trading card to be collected and discarded. No offence, Raul. Carl says it would not be appropriate for her to sponsor me when we will be fighting her. My new sponsor is called Long Haul Biological Waste Management Solutions. I know I am supposed to appear grateful. Are they going to show commercials for garbage trucks on my feed? This is not acceptable.

beats.headline: The boys arrive early
beats.text: CARL hired the boys from the Penis Parade and did not even tell me, which is the greatest thing since he hired Sledgie. He even hired Doctor Bones, the best DJ since DJ Diesel. It is as if my birthday started early, and it is not until November. Mongo is really excited too. I am sad Anaconda and Steelie are not here. Meanwhile I have been busy: Katia gave me Jola, and I used the Combo card on two of our problem cards and made it permanent with the Glow-Up, so we have two new totems. Shi Maria wanted that Glow-Up for herself.

beats.headline: D'nadia tried to delete us
beats.text: Odette puts the rejected action items on the screen. Mine is there, renaming Crown Prince Stalwart Captain Enormous, which Carl says the lawyers will not let me explain. Then three emergency items from Empress D'nadia, all rejected by the system: delete the NPCs on the Larracos level, bar crawlers from the game entirely, and remove our team or delete Carl and me outright. I thought she was my friend! First she sells my sponsorship, and now this. I am starting to think she really did vote against Mongo in the pet show.

beats.headline: Alone in the choosing room
beats.text: Zev says only the squad leader transfers, so it is me in the choosing room without Carl, and I tell him I do not want to be by myself. Then I am. I run around in a circle, and then I take Mongo out and lean on him. At the globe I choose Miami. My first opponent is an old man called Robert the Human, in a sailor suit much too small for him, with a doll and a stuffed dog for totems. I summon Geraldo. Then Mongo bites his throat, and it is over. The first thing I take is his hat.

beats.headline: The dixie cup
beats.text: My choices had labels, and I picked Miami, and then it said there was a problem and it was sending us to Iowa, and we landed in the Florida Keys with the key still in Iowa. I do not like glitches. They make me nervous. At least I have the dead man's sailor hat. Carl says it is a dixie cup, and that I cannot Hover in it and it costs ten intelligence. But it lowers my card draw countdown by two seconds, and it is quite jaunty. I already discussed it with Mordecai. I will wear it until I run out of cards.

beats.headline: Amateur hour
beats.text: It is the sixth fight before I have to use the deck at all. I summon our combo, Lazarus-A-Bang-Bang, with his cherubs and his street dogs and his organ music, and his bazooka shoots beetles. He points it at Carl. I tell him to put it down. Then I let Raul finish the ghost, for his self-confidence. The Reef Explorer drew two of his four totems and carried thirty Precision cards, which ruined his deck; he needed the perfect draw. Amateur hour. Lazarus calls everybody a pansy. I think MaeMae is jealous of his reveal sequence.

beats.headline: What if you die?
beats.text: The man in the diving suit had a strategy that could have worked, and I did not see it coming. There are thousands of cards and we do not know what they have. It is not fair. What happens if Carl dies? What would I do? And if something happened to me, what would Mongo do? I do not like being in charge of the deck. In that room by myself I thought I would never see him again. And we are losing Katia no matter what happens, and nobody talks about it. Sometimes I cannot breathe.

beats.headline: Jola the Yule Cat
beats.text: There is a big bat thing over a farmhouse with a swarm of invisible moths, and they are invisible and naked, so I summon the card Katia gave me. Jola. Snow, Christmas lights, a dirge, and a candle the size of a garbage can on the head of a house-sized Persian. The candle shows everything invisible, and the moths fly straight into it. Jola pins the Nightgaunt and eats him. Katia says they got the fairy tale all wrong: the real Yule Cat is a grump, and this one is quite the serial killer. It makes me wish our whole deck was cats.

beats.headline: Three seconds
beats.text: The idolized turkeys come for me, and I stand on Mongo, who is out cold, and slash at them. Then Carl kicks a hole in the mountain and the barn starts sliding off it, and I dig my back claws into Mongo so he does not go over. When it ends, Carl is dangling off a pole over the edge, and when he puts the dead ogre away, blood comes out of him everywhere. I jump to his shoulder and tell Mongo to run. Hang on, Carl. Three seconds. Puddle Jump.

beats.headline: I could do this one alone
beats.text: Carl is out for forty minutes, and I tell him so. I collected every card Sharp-Elbows dropped: her staff, which holds one of my spells, and a Golden Combo, a unique that is not consumable. So I suggest I do the last fight by myself. Or we skip it. He asks if I would rather fight other crawlers than get the key, and no, I suppose not. The truth is the motorcycle. It is the one from the prize carousel on the fourth floor, with the dent, and it is outside that trailer. I am trying to be more like him.

beats.headline: He does not have to go in
beats.text: The silhouette on the machine looks like a fatter Carl with a mustache. The nose is quite identical, and Carl tells me never to say that again. He takes everything in the yard he can lift, even the pieces of half a minivan, and I do not say a word. There is other stuff at the far side of the yard, and I do not say anything about that either. At the door I tell him he can wait out here with me; he does not have to go in. He says he needs to. So I wait.

beats.headline: The lady with the dog tattoo
beats.text: Carl goes inside and I keep watch. A lady appears in the yard out of nowhere; she walks right through me and her clothes do not go away. She has a pit bull tattooed on her NECK. Carl says be nice, he thinks she is his stepmom, but she is about Katia's age. She pulls something out of a flower pot I cannot see, because Carl took the pots, and she holds it against her chest and cries. Then she smokes a cigarette, pacing, throws it away and heads for the door. I warn him.

beats.headline: Judge Lucian
beats.text: It is Judge Lucian, one head of a hydra, with Sugar Cube and Miss Beatrice's mother. He deshrouds me with a smoke ring, which is cheating, and then he calls me overweight. I am NOT fat. I steal a card from him with The Thief, and after he snatches my new staff, he throws a snare at Shi Maria and the protection I stole from him eats it. She only has one snare space, and he wasted it. I used his own card against him. That will teach him to sniff cats.

beats.headline: Two totems she did not pick
beats.text: The hydra left us four totems and we may keep two. Carl says no to Frank, because he was a person, and no to Alpha Carl, though he does have great hair. So I send King Croissant off myself. Goodbye, little brother cousin. The disgusting dinosaur-eating meatball goes too. And then Leveled-Up Frank and Alpha Carl add themselves to my deck all on their own, and I cannot rip them until we get another card.

beats.headline: The greatest hat you've ever seen
beats.text: Carl says he is stepping out for air, which is fine, because I am busy. My present is a majorette hat that Li Jun found on the last floor, and it is the greatest hat anyone has ever seen. There is a real tree, which I knocked down, and a present for Mongo from Santa. We are playing pin the tail on the Krampus, which is a real game. The bopca is making us put the table together. Carl's present is shaped like a stupid book.

beats.headline: A metallic penis extension
beats.text: Carl has actually got that motorcycle to work. The copper chopper was handcrafted for us by Rory and Lorelai with a tailor-made sidecar. This is a metallic penis extension that comes with a free probation officer and a traumatic brain injury. I did not try to make him choose it on the prize carousel. I tried to make him choose the chaps. Samantha thinks it is sexy, and she is strapped to the handlebars making vroom noises.

beats.headline: I failed, Carl
beats.text: He switched hands with me. Three for three, and they were all Flee cards, and then he made me play one, and our key is gone to that cheater. We land in a dark swamp somewhere and I do not know where. I failed. I failed, Carl, and now Imani is going to die and it is my fault. Carl says not yet. He wants my deck rearranged, fast, and a card battle started with the duendes.

beats.headline: I knew it
beats.text: Ren sends me a message, and it opens with my title, as it should. She was trying to steal my experience the first time we met. She did cheat at the pet show. Mongo is the rightful champion. She is sorry. I KNEW IT. I knew it! Carl, did you hear that?

beats.headline: Sister Ines calls me a beast
beats.text: Sister Ines messages us. She knows we have the last key, the door is in a church, and she cannot let us open it. I tell her in capitals to just try and stop us, and I call her something about her breeding that comes out much worse than I intended. She says she can save Carl. She cannot save me, of course, as I am nothing but a rank beast. HEY. Then she says Carl must come to her, or her demons will destroy the church. This is what he gets for not letting Mongo eat her when we had the chance.

beats.headline: Nobody gets left behind
beats.text: Carl kneels in the alley and tells me he can still send me down the stairs if I want to go. He started this, and people are counting on it, so he is staying. He is going to take out the nun, free the demon from his shell, buff him as much as he can, and then get himself under the stairwell chamber. With no time left to dig. I headbutt his leg. If he does not go down the stairs, I do not go down the stairs. The Posse does not leave anybody behind. He says that line is cheesy. I stole it from a movie.

beats.headline: Minion Army, at last
beats.text: We got the Minion Army book on the very first floor, and I have never cast it, because it freezes you for minutes and it is meant for wars. With my Charisma I can select the entire mob out there and some of the birds, and it only takes four minutes. Imani and Samantha enhance it. I glow like a star and cannot move while the slugs charge early and a bicycle smashes straight through me. When it casts, Elle has hailed on nearly everything. Elle, you stole my experience! Then the birds I charmed start fighting each other, and I am getting experience after all.

beats.headline: The Thief, then Force Discard
beats.text: Carl asks if I have got this. I am the current reigning champion Persian in the galaxy, and a warlord, so yes, Carl. I play The Thief on the demon as he summons, and one of his cards flies into my hand: Banjo, a Hell Scrub, the tentacle cloud that drags a succubus off Carl. Then the demon has one card left and cannot play it, because the goddess will not let his claw move. She knows he is free to cast once he is empty. So I play Force Discard, and his last card goes poof. Suck it.

beats.headline: Why Are You Hitting Yourself
beats.text: The Satan demon guy will not listen to me. He is going to cast a different spell, and he and the vinegar lady are yelling at each other; I think they might actually be in love. She is almost out of cards, and Carl is on a beach with a crab. Samantha and I are going to have to do something drastic. So I cast Why Are You Hitting Yourself on him, and he punches himself in the face, twice. Samantha says that might have been a mistake. She thinks he is big mad.

beats.headline: Two cards, ripped
beats.text: Carl is bald and has no eyebrows, which I will not have in a sidekick. And the moment the battle ended I ripped Shi Maria's card. She will never hurt Mongo again. Then there is Paz, whom Katia let me take after the goddess died. His card says God Predator now, and it calls him a former crawler. I wanted to keep him and find a way to set him free, but Carl says no, it was never right to make him into a card. So I put one corner in my mouth and rip. Just like that. I do not get a player killer skull.

beats.headline: The crown comes due
beats.text: The Blood Sultanate is on this floor, and every royal in the line must slay the Sultan and all the other members of the royal family before descending to the tenth. I am a royal in the line. I have been since the first floor. I would like it noted that I was told to read the description.

beats.headline: She becomes a Deathbed Hellcat
beats.text: Thirty seconds to pick a card, and a whole new class, while I am covered in mud. Mordecai says nothing deity-themed, so the Consecrated Enchantress goes, sash and all, and I would never be a Halloween Aficionado. I pick Deathbed Hellcat: a long-range sniper and assassin. The range on every spell I have is quadrupled, my dexterity is much higher, my odds of an instakill are better, I can go invisible at will, and I keep most of my spells. It comes with a hat. And a ghoulie suit, whatever that is. I just love this for me right now.

beats.headline: A potion called MySpace Photo
beats.text: Mordecai hands me a potion that used to be called Charisma Cheat and is now called MySpace Photo, which is rude. I learn Shield, then I drink it. For two minutes it makes the system think my charisma is 193 instead of 163, and in those two minutes I put on the champion's shawl, so my constitution rises to 193 over the next few days. From two. I get a very rude Catfish achievement. The cloak takes Bad Attitude straight to level 15, and Wall of Fire, Heal Critter and Puddle Jumper are on their way. I was hoping for Fireball.

beats.headline: She calls it Cousin Oliver
beats.text: Carl has been keeping a pet from me. In all my life I have never felt a sense of betrayal this profound. It is a baby tummy acher Ren hoisted on him, it has five weaknesses, and it hopped into Mongo's mouth and he swallowed it. It is Cousin Oliver. Scrappy Doo. A late addition that makes a perfectly good cast worse. It gets three strikes, and it used one growling at Mongo. I offered to sell it to Katia's boyfriend for five gold. Carl says it is not for sale.

beats.headline: Not his fiancée
beats.text: Ferdinand has been telling people he is my fiancé. In the vestibule I make him say it: he is not really my fiancé. He adds not yet, and winks at Carl. I would rather have a sexual affair with the bloating corpse of a syphilis-infested cocker spaniel. Yes, I have his hat; I found it after the Butcher's Masquerade, and he can have it back when he stops being disgusting and changes the name of our alliance. Then Carl pulls out a bowler hat I have never been given.

beats.headline: The garbage truck people cancel
beats.text: I get a notification that a sponsorship has been cancelled. The garbage truck people, for a conflict of interest, whatever that means, and Carl says huh. At least I opened their box already. There is going to be an auction for a new one. I do hope it lines up properly with my brand this time. Veriluxx was a dud, Empress D'nadia sold my sponsorship, and it would be nice to have something to complement the Apothecary, even if she does sponsor half the dungeon.

beats.headline: A name she cannot change
beats.text: Fortress of Unyielding Power and Authority. It is a terrible name, and it will not let me change it, because the Sledge and the changelings kept changing it back and forth until the AI told them to shove it. Carl reads out the initials and laughs. I am absolutely not calling my castle that. It's obscene, and the bad guys are going to laugh at us. I give Florin a direct order not to spread it. He has already put it in the chat.

beats.headline: Skanked, and a hat
beats.text: The skunks' leader is a little battle wizard called Fancy Boy, in a starry hat, and I shout that nobody touch him because he's mine, and knock him out with a Magic Missile. That, apparently, is what was stopping the rest of them spraying. Now I am Skanked. Three hours, Charisma down seventy per cent, and nothing in my inventory takes it off. Mongo is sick. I got the hat, and it smells worse than I do. And I was supposed to be moral support for Katia's treatment.

beats.headline: None of my spells work
beats.text: The periscope screens have amazing resolution, much better than the stolen television in Carl's living room. Everything from a pawn shop is stolen, Carl. Then the pets come out of the fog, rot sticker behemoths as big as cars, full of the Gurgles, and I am feeling very useless all of a sudden. None of my spells work. Wait, Love Vampire works! It doesn't work on pets.

beats.headline: A prize for the most
beats.text: Warlord Donut, to everyone. The moment the first bomb drops, take the ear potion or put your earplugs in. Drink your invisibility, and go up and over, and don't stop running until you're in their trenches. The soldier who brings me the most dead cheese sticks gets a prize. The veterans say their old officers always threatened them. My army is different. Positive reinforcement worked with Mongo. Carl asks if I'm scared. Of course I am. It's more numb than anything. Nowadays it hits me more when it's done.

beats.headline: I got this
beats.text: The Empress has shield after shield, and my clockwork Mongos go through every one of them and her dress. She tells me she was my sponsor. She got me my glasses. Don't I like my glasses? Then Carl says he has changed his mind, he wants to do it himself. No, Carl. Please. I need you to step back and calm down. I've got this. When he does, I sit, lick my paw, and tell the Empress, darling, that Mongo would like to express his utmost disappointment at how she judged him during the pet show.

beats.headline: Carl is the party leader now
beats.text: Carl's base stats make him the strongest member of the party, so the system has made him Party Leader of the Royal Court of Princess Donut. Of my Royal Court. If he changes the name of the party I will leave, and then Mongo will come from a broken home. He says we'll keep the names and the titles. For now. Then I tell him the thing that is not for show. Throw that ring away, Carl. It's doing something to you. You're scaring me. He says not yet. It won't matter if it kills you first.

beats.headline: A spellbook called War Crime
beats.text: My 1914 box has given me a spellbook called War Crime, and I am not sure if I should read it. The spellbook itself is bleeding and crying and it's disgusting. Then the castle starts blowing up, and Bomo notices an extra door in the situational whatever it's called space: a door for the Reaver team's saferoom. They are doing what we were going to do. They are sneak attacking us through the saferoom door. The Bamboozle! Carl tells Bomo and Sledge to guard it.

beats.headline: Comrades, from the castle roof
beats.text: These people really need to follow orders faster. We need more team-building exercises. So my headset goes on, I jump on Mongo, and we land on the castle roof right above the door, where everyone can hear me, even the bad guys. Comrades! There are over a hundred of them behind that building, and some of them are wormheads who killed our friends. Are we going to let that stand? Alpha squad card reserves, to the roof! Everyone else, save your cards for the main force. Tina! Sic 'em! For the Posse!

beats.headline: The banners have to be wavy
beats.text: Rosetta insists we spend the last of our money defending the base, so I am spending it: a standalone hangar for five million gold, and another anti-air gun for five million, which is simply unfair when the other guys blew up the last one. And banners. Carl says we need to make the king angry enough to attack before his backup arrives, and nothing will do that like banners. I am the general and she is the colonel, so it's final. They need to be wavy. The bopca can't control the wind. Elle can.

beats.headline: From a Maserati to a dump truck
beats.text: The plan requires a mount the same size as the bad guy's, so I am riding Simoom, Ferdinand's albino rhinoceros, in a covered howdah with curtains I can barely see through. Mongo is whining. It's only for show, Mongo. Pretend mommy is acting in a movie and pretending someone else is her child. Push the horn to go, Kibben says, and if she gets to trotting, pat her behind. I will certainly not be smacking a rhinoceros's behind like some racetrack jockey. A gentle rub, he says. It's like moving from a Maserati to a dump truck, and she smells like one.

beats.headline: Mongo is all alone
beats.text: I had a whole plan to upset him, including banners making fun of the Maestro, and he spoils it by crying and talking about his daughter blowing up the sun. Most inconvenient. When it's over I ask Carl if he was telling the truth. Does that mean we're all about to die? That all of this was for nothing? We have to go back. Mongo is all alone! Then Carl tells me in private that the failsafe won't work, and calls it a hunch. That's a pretty big hunch, Carl.

beats.headline: Spill the tea
beats.text: I land in Carl's lap in Orren's office, and Growler Gary is alive! Carl gives me three quick taps. Gary needs relationship advice, and obviously Carl and Orren are no use. When Orren says the girl looks like Agatha I make one small remark about hygiene, and Gary cracks the desk with his hand. I do not flinch. Then I give him my advice. If a bunch of people want someone dead, that person is really good or really bad. Find out which. Even then, stay out of it unless you have no choice.

beats.headline: Much too poor
beats.text: While Carl was busy I had a little chat with Stalwart. He demanded his father's ring, his body and the credits. I told him his father's skin is now a powder room rug, which it is not, and that his father called him a disappointment before he died, which is the one thing I am not lying about. He says he will boil the fur off my skin. I told him he is much too poor to be talking to me like this. I do feel a little bad about the poor line.

beats.headline: Filth, clutter, squalor
beats.text: Carl's new tattoo is a little crooked. The system calls it expert quality, but I should have been there. Closing off the saferoom from the base is causing all sorts of problems. We have been separated, Tipid has to build more bathrooms, the whole base smells like Carl's friend Sam, and nobody can take a shower. I will not have a filthy army. With filth comes clutter, and with clutter comes squalor. Carl says to tell Tipid I want showers. I think Carl should tell him. I don't like being separated like this.

beats.headline: Princess TV, and a word for Vinata
beats.text: Carl asked me to stall, so I stall. Everyone at this table has their own channel and the Princess Posse does not, which is quite unfair, so I propose Princess TV: reruns of the Earth classics, Golden Girls, an exposé on Mongo's greatest kills. Imagine the ratings. Then Odette says the Sultanate made Blood Hunter, and I realise which show that is. The one with the pterodactyl and the vampire hunter. I look the naga princess up and down and address her directly for the first time. Oh, honey. And I thought I was going to be the one who killed you.

beats.headline: It should be purple
beats.text: The Nest should be purple. Gray is clinical. Boring. And it needs flags, and its own unit patch, with Mongo on it. Toyotomi says it is the colour of granite because it is made of granite. My tiara has thirty-five of its ninety-nine skills and upgrades now; the newest is Perfect Night Vision, drained out of a hat, so I can see the builders at the very top in the dark. Carl keeps asking Toyotomi the same questions over and over. I'll be fine, Carl. Especially if the tower is painted purple.

beats.headline: I do not ask permission
beats.text: They installed the wireless PA speakers in time, the deluxe package, with more speakers than towers, and it hooks into my headset with one of those recording studio boards with all the slidy dials. Distortion. Reverb. Something called a phaser. Carl says to get Li Na's permission before I use it. I am a warlord. I do not ask permission, I give orders. I will warn them, though. Carl says to aim my shots, breathe, and make each one count. I know I can do this. I am a warlord.

beats.headline: A ball of everyone
beats.text: Everyone Eris summoned is in one pile beside the Dream castle, friends and enemies all mixed in, and if the invulnerability goes they will be crushed. Carl wants to go. I tell him to finish his mission and let me deal with the pile. Rolling Battle Formation, from that skunk's stinky wizard hat. It is an Atrocity spell, and the tower makes it really, really big. I can drive it like a remote control. Unfortunately Meatus got pulled in too, still wrapped around Eris. In my defence, I did not know the dink would be included.

beats.headline: A song for Harpocrates
beats.text: Harpocrates is chasing my ball, trying to get his stolen wiener back, and guys are single-minded about that. So I tell Li Na's people to cover their ears and I get on the PA, with reverb and a little delay. Hey, dickless. It's gone. You should accept your body how it is. My friend Lil Wayne wrote you a song. It's Lollipop, and it's bass-heavy, and the ground shakes, and he stops and covers his ears. It's working. I'm starting a battle playlist. Message me your songs.

beats.headline: A second atrocity
beats.text: The ball reaches the field of corpses and I cast You're Not Done Yet, tower-enhanced, on all of them at once. The system calls it another Atrocity and me a naughty kitty. Thousands of skins come up and go looking for the Dream and the Reaver soldiers inside the ball. Then I start hitting it with Magic Missile to break it open, and Carl and Li Na both tell me to stop. Our friends are in there, Carl, with fleshers crawling all over them. He wants it kept whole and rolled toward the city. So I set it rolling toward Larracos.

beats.headline: Donkey Kong
beats.text: Lucia is in the tower, coming up the stairs, shouting for Mongo, and Bomo and the others are dead. I cannot leave; there is a net. I tell Carl to get the war mages, because the castle is more important than me. He says he is coming and to do Donkey Kong. So I hit the switch, and the stairs turn into a ramp, and I roll barrels. The sleep barrel does not work. She crawls on the ceiling and blocks explosions. Mute does not work on her. I have a better idea. I summon Raul.

beats.headline: Level seventy-four
beats.text: I am in my ghillie suit at the parapet, sniping. The war mage atop that death ray tower is not so tough with his head blown off. Carl says to focus on the towers hitting the Nest, and then he holds out his arms, and I blink and jump into them and go round his neck like I used to when he came home from work. I went up this tower at level 65. I am 74 now. My Magic Missile is level fifteen, and it tripled in power. And Rend saved my boy.

beats.headline: A tattoo on the right flank
beats.text: Rosetta says it has to be a tattoo, with Milk etching words of power over it, and Edgar wants a spot on my backside shaved as big as his foot. I never agreed to a tattoo! Carl says I don't have to, and nobody will fault me. I tell him about the scars. I hoped none of them would be on the outside. He says if I choose it, it is a badge of honour. Fine. Only if he gets a matching one. And not a tramp stamp. Then I ask Edgar what he is drawing. A dog.

beats.headline: A dog that licks itself
beats.text: It's done, and I have received two very rude achievements, one calling me a traitor. But I did get the spell, at level two. It came from a god called Wepwawet, in the Court of Nekhebit, and I can worship Odette now too! Cover it up. It is getting lasered off on the next floor. Not yet, says Milk, and writes words of power over it, which stings. Apparently the dog underneath lifts its leg and starts licking itself. I am not looking. The spell has gone up to level fifteen.

beats.headline: Three baps, and again
beats.text: Carl says anything but fire, so it is Bijanbi and Astral Paw. The messages call me the Oak Fell, and a champion, and then I can't move and my health is draining. Outside, the paw hangs over the hole with thousands of soldiers and a god floating up under it. Carl gets the healing scroll on me. I shouldn't have picked Astral Paw. I have to do it myself. I can feel them under my paw. Li Na builds a lattice of chains and says it is all she can build. I close my eyes and swipe down. Three quick baps. Then again, until the screaming stops.

beats.headline: Level one hundred and thirty-five
beats.text: I sit up and compose myself. I still have my Former Child Actor benefits, with the Oak Fell class and the champion title on top. I don't have to worship Nekhebit, only nobody outside her court. For strength I pick Muscle Mommy, so Mongo gets a quarter of mine. Brain Trust for intelligence. Wholesale Discount, for my charisma topping two hundred. Level one hundred and thirty-five! I am once again the strongest crawler in the dungeon. Mongo stays caged. If he eats any of that Meatus, I could never look at him the same again.

beats.headline: Druid spells and a vermin call
beats.text: My Oak Fell spells are enormous. Raise Forest sprouts trees and plants over a kilometre per level of the spell. Another turns water into salt water. Gather Ye, Vermin draws every mammal under a certain size within ten kilometres, which is clearly the pervert AI's doing so Carl can summon squishables. Map the All Tree costs one mana and only works on the twelfth floor and deeper. And Carl can play his bagpipes now! We can play at Louis's second wedding. He says the bagpipes are staying in the folder.

beats.headline: Epitome Tagg's Sexy Mother
beats.text: I didn't get to say goodbye to Katia. Then Mordecai needs Tagg distracted while they have Louis open, so I ask him how he will look his mother in the eye, knowing Louis had sex with her. He insists it was a changeling. So I change my name to Epitome Tagg's Sexy Mother and ask Louis to come help with my hand stuck in the washing machine. He screams at me to change it back. I can't. No more name changes until tomorrow. Carl says stall, not provoke. We're playing good cop, bad cop.

beats.headline: We just need to kill you
beats.text: Huanxin wants Katia to choose so they can go. Darling, I have a better idea. Laundry Day, level sixteen now, and she is ripped out of the goddess onto a circle of words of power where she can't teleport. My Claw, nearly fifteen, takes her shields. I have Katia's knee pads on, the goddess's boon gives me 500 percent, and Carl's party bonus another 500. The Apothecary's box was a weapon mount, and Katia's crossbow is on my back. Mordecai loads one bolt. We don't need to kill the gods and goddesses to win. The crossbow fires. We just need to kill you.

beats.headline: They are not going to break me
beats.text: Katia left two things on the table. Her card from the last floor, with Annie the skull-headed bird on it, which I take, and a bra with Carl's face on one cup, which Elle takes. I feel really bad now about having pooped in Mordecai's mother's ashes. It was supposed to be a grand gesture. Carl says don't you dare tell Mordecai. At the stairwell he asks if I'm doing okay. I'm going to miss her. But they are not going to break me. No matter how hard they try.

beats.headline: Her new attorney
beats.text: A Naga called Princess Chandra, Esquire, informs me that she is my attorney now, not Quasar, and that I have been put under a conservatorship with Carl as my guardian. She has married him, too, through some widow's law, and she has seized the Posse's accounts. I refuse every deal, since Carl is refusing his. Then I read every one of her papers and tell her what they say about her. And, for any reporters watching, I am most definitely not offering fifty million credits to anyone who turns her inside out on my behalf.

beats.headline: Assassin of Sekhmet
beats.text: Four minutes to pick a new class, which is simply not enough time for a decision of this importance. The Las Vegas Showgirl comes with a feathered hat for Mongo. Mordecai suggests Zoo Warden, which I will not dignify. Then there is a whole new tab tied to my deity titles, and even Mordecai says it is new to him. I take Assassin of Sekhmet: a healing aura, a hat, and accessories for every pet in the party. And straight away, a very nasty message from Khepri, the bug god, saying he is forming a death cult in my name.

beats.headline: Two missiles for a manatee
beats.text: The manatee is called Miss Talulah, she is level ninety, and she smells simply awful. Two magic missiles and she collapses into the water with holes in her you could put a soccer ball through. I am the number one crawler at level 135, so this is hardly surprising. Then a notification: I must choose the fate of my kill. Keep it dead for regular experience, or let the audience vote. It says the second choice will be more fun. Naturally, I pick the second choice. Results pending.

beats.headline: Fatty
beats.text: A unicorn in a tumbleweed calls me fatty, and the bug-eyed rat in a racing helmet on his head calls me a corpulent swine. Fatty! I stand in the road and explain that I am practically twice their levels and that their mount is very likely flammable, and Carl tells me to let them go around, which I do not, and then Mongo leans on the horn and they run over everything anyway. As soon as the next race starts, I am setting them on fire. Also, my vote came back: the people have chosen Otto the slime guy to be the manatee's stand-in in the arena. That is all it says.

beats.headline: A godslayer box
beats.text: Forty boxes, and the achievements are mostly rude. Emergency Gremlin scrolls by the dozen, apparently for when the truck breaks down mid-race. Crossbow bolts that pin whatever they hit in place. A crupper that matches my champion cloak. And then the celestial godslayer box, which is only smoke: it becomes Meatus, and a smoky paw comes down on him, and Rosetta says she can still taste it. No prize falls out. My right front paw, the one I used for the War Crime, starts to glow, and it hurts, and I stretch my claws, and the kitchen table rips in half.

beats.headline: Blue claws, and caps
beats.text: The claws glow blue. Blue! Like cheap LED lights, and they will not turn off. Mordecai calls it a boon. They cut through anything, which is lovely until one considers my litter box, and Carl's shoulder, and biscuits. Rosetta finds claw caps on the shop wall and buys red ones, so the glow comes out purple, which I suppose will have to do. Then the crupper's description, which is about a gnoll I killed and his children, and I do not wish to discuss it. It made me choose a spell. Puddle Jumper is now level sixteen.

beats.headline: Rule number one
beats.text: Prepotente has a biscuit that makes whoever eats it fall hopelessly in love with whoever fed it to them, and he came to me for advice, which was the correct instinct. My advice is absolutely not. She would be level one and stuck with us, and it is a crime against nature besides. So I am compiling him a list of rules to live by. Rule number one: do not use magic to make someone fall in love with you. It is creepy. Rule number two is to stop arguing with me.

beats.headline: Is Katia okay?
beats.text: A greenroom at the bottom of the ocean and no snacks, which is not how Prepotente described this show. And Lexis is here! She has a minute, she says, so I ask the only thing that matters: is Katia okay? Something strange happened at the kinder facility after Faction Wars. A third party has appeared and is protecting it, and it is confused. She believes Katia is okay. Then her tablet beeps and all the colour goes out of her face, and I do not get to ask anything else.

beats.headline: The War Crime question
beats.text: A goat judges me worthy and asks which three spells I would combine if I cast War Crime a second time. I stiffen. Then I compose myself, because we are live and I am a professional. It will depend on the circumstances. Nothing is off the table. But I cannot cast it until the twelfth floor, and Carl and I must first get through these next two. The goat nods. I ask whether it is my turn to ask. It says yes, and the table turns to the next goat anyway.

beats.headline: A throne called Dorota
beats.text: The audience voted me a throne, which shows some of them have taste. It is a Smart Companion Royal Pet Throne, the Ultimate Diamond Pampered Pet Princess edition, and the moment I sit on it a little fluffy bed appears, it holds me steady like a gyro, and it feeds me snacks on demand. It came with a creepy man's voice, so I had it changed to a woman with a Polish accent, and I have named her Dorota. She agrees with everything I say. Dr. Metcalf is jealous.

beats.headline: A letter from Luca Di
beats.text: An entry in my Banquet Fit for a Princess, from a crawler I do not remember: Luca Di, a Pastamancer, who gave me his train hat on the fourth floor. His mother had dementia. On the third floor she took a race that mended her mind, and they talked, properly, before she fell on the bubble level. He says I saved that for him. He says it is all right to forgive myself for War Crime. The spell he left me is Temporary Macaroni.

beats.headline: A tunnel of cannelloni
beats.text: I killed more than ten thousand of them and did not go up a level. That is an outrage. Then the skulls come up out of the road and down out of the sky, and I cast Temporary Macaroni, which I have had for about a minute, and I chain it: uncooked cannelloni, a foot thick, a tunnel of it. When Gluteus passes out on the wheel I rip myself free of Dorota's belt and hold the accelerator down with both paws. We win.

beats.headline: Easier not to like him
beats.text: The gauge at the Lollipop was clearly broken. I sang Journey and it did not move, and Finley says I did fine, and I thank him. Then Osvaldo is in our heat and tells Carl something extremely vulgar, so I tell him he is only alive because of me and Carl, and he is a straight-to-video leprechaun. Carl says he is not an enemy. He is not going to help us. It is us or him. It will be easier if we stay not liking each other.

beats.headline: The Astral Paw, and a bite
beats.text: Cannibals, hundreds of them, dropping out of the trees and bursting on our shield. I swipe my Astral Paw and sweep the arch clear like pieces off a chessboard. Elle calls me terrifying, which is fair. It is a lot stronger than it was, but it does not last, and now I cannot cast it for eight hours, and I killed about eighty and did not go up a level, which is ridiculous. Then something bites my bottom. I believe it was the dog tattoo.

beats.headline: What she tells the shark
beats.text: I Hover up to the ceiling and whisper to him, and he flips down and lands right by the truck. Carl asks what I said. I told him it is true, it could happen at any moment, but if we worry about things we cannot control, we ruin the things we can. And even if he is annoying, he is family now, and he should tell us when he is in trouble, because family helps. Mongo, mind Mommy and guard Hedy.

beats.headline: Relationship advice for a pig
beats.text: Carl wants a distraction, so I take the driveway with my headset microphone and address the fake tiger people. My charisma is high enough now that All Eyes on Me works with plain talking, no singing required. I explain to Penelope that throuples in which two members are at each other's throats end in heartbreak, and then Miss Piggy, and Piglet, and Wilbur, and Peppa. They cannot look away. By the time I wave goodbye they do not even know they were charmed.

beats.headline: Jezebel the hedgehog
beats.text: Satan is a hedgehog, a kaiju-sized one, and I would bet anything he talks with a fake British accent, and I do not care what Carl says, this has nothing to do with Tacoma. Yes, there was a Cutest in Show, and yes, I was a kitten, and yes, the winner was a baby hedgehog from a rescue named Jezebel, and Miss Beatrice sulked all day. It was fixed from the beginning. Who names a hedgehog Jezebel? It hardly matters now. I have raised the toad, head caved in and all, to drive us.

beats.headline: We are calling her Chachi
beats.text: WE'RE JUST GOING TO CALL HER CHACHI. I only have so much room on my cut-and-paste, and I am not filling it with a name that long. Anyway, it is concert day. Prepotente is coming, and he is singing as well, which is lovely for him. Mine is a surprise. It will be a duet with Carl, and he has to take a great many potions and scrolls first so that he does not mess it up. Then we go and collect the pig from the empty house.

beats.headline: She is not a weapon
beats.text: Carl says we need people like Li Na, because she is so strong. She is not a weapon, Carl. She is a person. I like her, of course I do, but we cannot let her keep hurting people, and we certainly cannot let Zhang kill himself to stop her. That is not right, and I told Zhang no, twice. We will find something to fix this. Somebody has to talk some sense into her. It is the only way.

beats.headline: Robbed of a perfect score
beats.text: My part was perfect, Auto-Tuned and in key, and in the middle of a chorus I shot the axe out of a Draconian's hand before he could put it in Dong's head. Then, on my very last line, a paralysed kappa fell backward right into me, and now there is a sign over my head that says FAILED. I was robbed of a perfect score. Carl has to go through the glowing door by himself. We are never going to mention this again. I do love that song, though.

beats.headline: A letter from a half-orc
beats.text: The newest entry in my Feast book is from Mees Koning, a half-orc mage, final level sixty-three. Before the battle at the southern border I stopped at his stinger unit and told him I liked his fangs, and we talked for maybe a minute, and he says it was the first time anyone had been nice to him just to be nice. He was inside the ball when I cast my Atrocity. He drew me a magnet, a very well-shaded one. It is called Big-Ass Magnet. I did not choose the name.

beats.headline: Twice now
beats.text: At the shop terminal, as the white bot sold, Mordecai's hood came down, his head was on fire, and he said something about the Oak Fell in a deep voice that was not his usual one. Then he blinked, patted the fire out and carried on as if nothing had happened. He said that would only happen once. That is twice now. Carl says he told us to ignore it. It is really scary, and I do not like it, and nobody is explaining it to me.

beats.headline: Not a kangaroo anymore
beats.text: The Dominators' car went through a hole in the floor, and I saw it, so I made Carl stop and reverse. It is a ten-metre drop, and horrible little dolls are tearing the car apart. Carl wants to jump down. And then what, Carl? You are not a kangaroo anymore. I got this. I land on the car and cast Puddle Jumper. I cannot teleport Corky into the truck, so I bring us both up to the road beside it, which is the next-best thing. My fur is smoking.

beats.headline: Laundry Day, and then a magnet
beats.text: Grull came crashing through a wall with that awful Maestro riding inside him, so I cast Laundry Day, and the orc dropped out of the god's chest into the molten metal. We do not have time to kill you now. Maybe next time! But Corcunda is still marked, and he and Dong decide to go and meet the god themselves, and I try to say no, and I cannot finish saying it. So I cast Big-Ass Magnet on Dong's lance, the spell that was meant for the Dominators' car. Every screw in the room goes with them.

beats.headline: Dong is dead
beats.text: We came in last place, and the stupid unicorn won by going over the factory instead of through it, which is cheating, and Osvaldo agrees with me. Dong is dead. He was my friend. Grigori says some people believe death is only a movement on to another plane, and that Dong did not think it was the end. Perhaps. It is still horrible for those of us who are still here. Grigori agrees.

beats.headline: Not speaking to Carl
beats.text: I am not speaking to Carl. His strategy has him leaving the party for the eleventh floor, so that I do not get hurt, as if I cannot look after myself. So I am sitting in the stables while Rosetta explains dungeon lore that will not matter because we will all be dead in a few hours. A child who can take the powers of gods and use them for herself, just like that Spock on the show with the cheerleader. Carl laughed. You are not allowed to laugh at my observations, Carl.

beats.headline: The message board caught him
beats.text: Let the record show it WAS NOT ME. It was the Princess Posse message board. Linus is the brother, which was the big theory, and WriggleInDew2023 of the Mongo Mommies Valtay chapter said all along he was no Valtay agent, and she will be thrilled. He leaned far too hard into the romantic material, which real admirers rarely say out loud, and one of his brother's friends noticed his tattoo was wrong. Honestly. He could at least have taken acting lessons. He is worse than Prepotente, and I mean that with love.

beats.headline: Plan Mach Schnell
beats.text: Carl is a dog now and cannot even say the name of the plan properly. It is Mach Schnell. Dorota rolls the window down for me, bless her. When the light goes green I am through the window as smoke and onto the roof before the vine has finished dying, and before Osvaldo's gnu has stopped staggering I take that tiresome unicorn's head off with one swipe and his horn goes into my inventory. The announcement is complimentary. I prefer decisive. Carl is wagging again.

beats.headline: Astral Paw on the Cadillac
beats.text: The Russian car throws itself up on end in the middle of the lobby to make a run for the exit, after all our planning and all Imani's pleading. The APV and Chris's truck fire into its shield, Prepotente throws something, and the shield flickers out. So I cast Astral Paw and the Cadillac simply ceases to exist, all in less than a second. Three new skulls over my head before Carl can even think a rude word.

beats.headline: She tells the giant Imani it is a dream
beats.text: The giant Imani is sitting in the lobby holding Gucci, and the building will not let her leave, and she says she should have left them all when she had the chance. So I switch on my headset microphone. Darling, this is a dream. Out in the real world you already left: Detroit, then Washington, and friends named Yolanda and Brandon and Elle, and a man named Chris, and happily ever after. Close your eyes. Before that I moved Onikuma and Old Shuck into our garage with Dwight's keys. We will need them. I am not discussing it.

beats.headline: The pickle class
beats.text: Mordecai, help me pick a class. Comeback Kid comes with a movie deal, which is obviously me, but CARL says my Glass Cannon ruins it, because you get all your old bad parts back too. So: Elite Gurkha Warrior. It sounds like a pickle. Extra skills for pets and mercenaries, a big claw upgrade for Mongo, Cockroach to fifteen. Carl says I am going to pick it, so I nearly didn't. I picked it. Also, his psychotic wife tried to accept a deal on my behalf, and then got scared and vanished.

beats.headline: An advance copy of a spell
beats.text: My new spell book is a paperback, which is common. Tome of Gatekeeper, an Advance Reader Copy: I may install it now, and it works on the twelfth floor. It takes away a target's class skills for a while, even a god's. The duration is nerd math. And I got a Legendary box for seeing the shadow mimic before he revealed himself, and a Legendary Steed upgrade so Mongo can pull a cart.

beats.headline: Her title goes with his
beats.text: I do not like this. Carl's royal bodyguard title has gone, and now his says nothing at all. Then he grins and tells me mine has gone too. MINE. I am not the one who left the stupid party, and I cannot even add a new one. This is so unfair. At least the float is beautiful: Requite Dahlias from my Sprout Forest, black and gold and magenta and white, which match the Gurkha blankets, on every square inch of everything.

beats.headline: I love you too
beats.text: At the arena door Carl lifts me off his shoulder and holds me much too tightly and tells me to get to Elle and Imani and stay away. I know the plan. I am scared, and I say so. Then he says he loves me, and then he starts on if this doesn't work, and I will not let him jinx it. People keep asking how he would react if something happened to me. Nobody asks me. I love him too.

beats.headline: Two bolts, and Puddle Jumper
beats.text: Now. One of Lucia's loop-de-loop traps swaps me into the room and the pig out to Taranis's feet. Scorpion's Bite on my back, Katia's Bolt of Ophiotaurus loaded, and it goes straight into Emberus's eye. The second, one of my Danforth bolts, goes into the other, and he cannot move. Toodles. Puddle Jumper, level seventeen, and Carl and I are outside the arena door. When he tells me to get off his motorcycle, I tell him exactly where he can go.

beats.headline: His inventory is a disgrace
beats.text: Eris swaps everybody's pockets and I get Carl's, and it is not organised. Rocks, CARL. Why are there rocks. Why is a chicken and goblin recipe book in his hotlist. He shouts at me to combine the ball in slot ten with the biscuit in slot twelve, and my hotlist only has ten slots, so I search and combine and drop it into his xistera, very fast, while the centipede glows.

beats.headline: The wrong biscuit
beats.text: I am sitting in the dirt and not being sarcastic, which should tell everyone something. Carl sends me a party request and I accept it without a word. Then I have to tell him. Don't get mad. The inventory was happening so fast. The goo drains away and there is a centipede with lips and a red bow, and she is not a pet. She is Sexy Scolopendra, level one, crawler, in our party. I gave him the wrong biscuit.
